about: Wiki quests confidently matched to a script directory of both servers and/or the wiki_quest of auxiliary progress tracks (track_owners.json), where the source has no quest-log entry (kind script_only, §6.2/§6.5 gap). title must exact-match samples/quest-coverage-2026-09-27.json; key overrides the default identity slug (slug(title)) only where the wiki spelling and the script directory diverge (apostrophe, article, typo, plural), so the readiness join (script directory name, normalised) still finds the quest. ots_questlog.py fails on a title missing from the coverage sample or a key colliding with an existing quest.
